user.title: Connect to Simyo
user.description: Sign in with the same phone number and password you use for the Mijn Simyo app.

mfa.title: Verify Simyo login
mfa.description: Enter the six-digit code Simyo sent to your configured SMS or email address. The code is used once and is not stored. If the session has expired, restart setup.

error.cannot_connect: Could not complete the Simyo login. Check the integration logs for the failure category and HTTP status.
error.client_update_required: Simyo no longer accepts this app version. Update the integration.
error.unexpected_response: Simyo returned an unsupported login response. Additional verification may be required; check the integration logs for the HTTP status.
error.invalid_code: The verification code is invalid. Check the latest code and try again.
error.rate_limited: Simyo has temporarily limited authentication attempts. Wait before trying again; do not repeatedly request codes.

abort.already_configured: This phone number is already configured.
abort.mfa_expired: The verification session has expired. Restart setup or reauthentication to request a new code.
